title: feat(connectPagination): add default value on getConfiguration
body: This PR updates the implementation for `getConfiguration` inside `connectAutocomplete`. It adds a default `page` once the widget is mounted. This default value is useful for federated search, without the widget is **always** controlled by its parent.
